clarifications: Task scope is strictly 5 budget-counted files.
Normal G-031 limit of 5 files is observed with zero overrides.
G-041 semantic authorization is FALSE (zero semantic files modified).
G-042 guardrails authorization is FALSE (zero guardrails modified).

Simulation time uses explicit integer representation (TypeScript number validated with Number.isSafeInteger); negative safe integers accepted; safe-integer range is an implementation choice; no concrete units defined.

Event categories follow exact 6-tier canonical precedence (1. Hard Interrupt / Control, 2. Scheduled Completion / State Transition, 3. Player Input, 4. Derived Events, 5. Skill Trigger / Activation, 6. Effect Resolution).

EventBatch is an implementation choice, not canonically identical to an Event Wave; each batch contains events sharing exactly one timestamp and one category; sibling peers carry no semantic ordering.
Execution primitive executeEventBatch consumes strictly ONE EventBatch; mixed collections spanning multiple timestamps or categories are prohibited; multi-batch automatic coordination is deferred.
Snapshot isolation: sibling evaluators in a batch evaluate against the same pre-batch snapshot without observing sibling staged intents; no direct mutation callbacks.
Effect Intents: staged during evaluation; carry no semantic priority based on array order; conflict resolution deferred under GAP-AS-006.
Atomic commit: exactly one pure post-evaluation resolver/commit boundary produces committedState from pre-batch snapshot and staged intents.
Derived events: produced strictly after commit from committed results; emitted in derivedEvents for future processing; no intra-wave recursive processing.
Bootstrap compatibility: getDomainState() is preserved with gameplayImplemented: false.
